task.title: 使用高级架构控件
task.shortdesc: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：使用高级架构控件. Reach advanced schema-shell and preference controls from All Settings without treating Guided as the complete editor.

prereq.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：使用高级架构控件. Open All Settings in Catalog mode.

context.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：使用高级架构控件. Advanced controls remain deliberate. All Settings is the superset for schema-backed policies and preferences that are not first-class Guided controls.

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：使用高级架构控件. Switch to Catalog mode and open the advanced schema or preference disclosure.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：使用高级架构控件. Review whether the control is Guided-covered, All-Settings-only, raw, deprecated, or schema-dependent.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：使用高级架构控件. Edit only the advanced control needed for the profile goal.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：使用高级架构控件. Validate and save before returning to Guided, JSON, or the Library.

info.note: 警告：保存前请检查架构、值来源以及更改后果。

result.p: All Settings 显示配置文件的预期状态，并且该操作可在审查时解释。 The advanced setting is reached and changed deliberately without duplicate default editors.

postreq.p: 恢复：如果结果不符合预期，请清除筛选器、返回详细信息面板或打开相关主题。 Recovery: if the control is unsupported in the selected schema, leave it unchanged and document the schema boundary.
